svg.desc: All 46 parent segments remain visible. Evidence handoff 10/10; historical recovery 4/5; permissions and grants 10/10; finalization and sessions 8/8; workloads and native 3/6 with two active and one todo; providers and operations 0/7 with three active and four todo. Source 8e6e265fb8808d128f5fd40deacc8716aadaec45 connects independently signed refresh policy, stable per-version claims, complete capacity proofs, one token POST, encrypted raw and issued retention and atomic credential/generation replacement. Refresh precedes metadata pinning; enrolled dispatch is read/check-only. Control-plane checks do not revoke data-plane cached leases. Genuine holder barriers, refresh cleanup, reconnect, setup, global ownership, ordinary-app transport and independent verification remain open. Counts are not readiness or effort percentages. No build, browser, runtime, provider contact, AWS/spend or pilot credit; production acceptance remains 0/6.
